question: What is the effect of defending perception by appeal to an all-pervading self in contact with all senses?
premises: A proponent speaks in defense of a view based on an all-pervading self in contact with all senses.
That proponent is intent on evasion rather than clear reasoning.
Such speech misleads those who are not discerning.
inference: Therefore the appeal to an all-pervading self contacting all senses functions as a deceptive evasion, not a sound explanation of perception.
uncertainties: The verse ends by introducing the view to be examined further, so the sentence is transitional.
plain_english: One who, intent on evasion, speaks of cognition as arising from an all-pervading self in contact with all the senses deceives the deluded.
